cond_0001.intro:
As a Sales Finance Business Partnering Manager, you will act as the mini-CFO for the sales divisions that you will support. You will drive goal-setting, revenue insights, forecasting and performance management. You will partner with sales leaders on ideas to improve their P&L. This includes identifying underlying trends and consulting on strategic business decisions. Your role is to translate complex data into actionable insights, which means you can focus on the details and also solve big-picture challenges.
The Sales Finance team's mandate is to optimize value creation for pinners, advertisers and [Company name masked] through disciplined business leadership and seamless financial execution. We do this by developing financial forecasts, providing decision support through analysis, generating internal reports, monitoring key performance indicators and scaling financial processes. We are looking for an expert in finance and strategy who uses an analytical, collaborative, results-oriented approach to drive progress.

Excellent communication and presentation skills (Google Slides).

You will drive goal-setting, revenue insights, forecasting and performance management. You will partner with sales leaders on ideas to improve their P&L. This includes identifying underlying trends and consulting on strategic business decisions. Your role is to translate complex data into actionable insights, which means you can focus on the details and also solve big-picture challenges.
The Sales Finance team's mandate is to optimize value creation for pinners, advertisers and [Company name masked] through disciplined business leadership and seamless financial execution. We do this by developing financial forecasts, providing decision support through analysis, generating internal reports, monitoring key performance indicators and scaling financial processes. We are looking for an expert in finance and strategy who uses an analytical, collaborative, results-oriented approach to drive progress. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of revenue data and financial trends.
cond_0409.responsibilities: Drive goal-setting, forecasting, revenue insights and performance management for key sales divisions. Partner with the Sales and Sales Strategy & Operations teams on developing insights and trend analysis of revenue drivers. Leverage technical expertise to execute quantitative modeling and analysis. Provide weekly and quarterly reporting and insights for a senior Executive Team audience.
cond_0409.requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as economics, business, engineering or 5+ years of experience in sales finance, investment banking, consulting or a related quantitative field. Well experienced with providing strategic advice to senior sales leaders. Exceptional spreadsheet skills with experience creating financial models and dashboards. Basic SQL experience is preferred but not required. Excellent communication and presentation skills (Google Slides). Ability to multi-task and deliver against timelines. Entrepreneurial, flexible, and collaborative.
cond_0409.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0409.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

cond_0648.intro:
We are looking for a Sales Finance Business Partnering Manager to join our team.
As a Sales Finance Business Partnering Manager, you will work alongside the sales divisions you support, acting as a financial partner to help guide goal-setting, revenue insights, forecasting, and performance management. You will coordinate with sales leaders on ideas to improve their P&L, including identifying underlying trends and contributing to strategic business decisions. The role involves translating complex data into actionable insights, balancing attention to detail with broader business challenges.
The Sales Finance team's mandate is to optimize value creation for pinners, advertisers and [Company name masked] through disciplined business leadership and seamless financial execution. We do this by developing financial forecasts, providing decision support through analysis, generating internal reports, monitoring key performance indicators and scaling financial processes. We are looking for an expert in finance and strategy who uses an analytical, collaborative, results-oriented approach to drive progress.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Work with key sales divisions to support goal-setting, forecasting, revenue insights, and performance management.
Coordinate with the Sales and Sales Strategy & Operations teams on developing insights and trend analysis of revenue drivers.
Contribute technical expertise to execute quantitative modeling and analysis.
Share weekly and quarterly reporting and insights with a senior Executive Team audience.
